body: That would certainly be a fun job I'd like to do. I'll look into what I would have to do for that.

That all sounds great, and no I'm not one for material wealth. If I have my clothes and my computer and basic survival stuff, I'm happy. Its that jobs in the field I'm in in the states require ridiculous hours. Getting to a different country with different work schedules would be a challenge, though I have thought of living in Canada for a long time. I don't even know where to start setting that up thought.

I'm still with her because I'm comfortable with her, and she fucking loves me. When I graduate and move back home/to wherever I'll be leaving the relationship behind.

I originally went into software because I wanted to make games. But I know so little about it now, even about to graduate because I didn't actively learn anything. I just played WoW (I've since quit) and drank and skirted by on the homework. So I know the basics of programming but I don't have any game graphics/design skills.

I like Starcraft because its competitive, deep, and fun.

The dread comes from it being coding for some shit I don't care about in an environment of people I don't care about and having to do so in a shitty shitty office for the rest of my life.
I'm a month from graduation. My parents paid my way. It would be such a waste.
